Positive roots at most m yield legitimate independent geometric factors. Strict convexity of log(1+up/(1-p)) and an explicit positive pair-balancing identity prove the all-z majorization order and mean comparisons. Majorization extrema and the p_i approaching one lower bound give the sharp fixed-budget regimes. A standalone absorbing-state solver passes 405 exact rational checks, including polynomial node signs. value.rationale: The model directly asks whether equal or concentrated type-specific failure risks are better at a fixed total reliability budget. The theorem classifies the entire hitting-time law by positive independent geometric factors in precise interlacing intervals, not only a statistic or a finite table value. It proves an all-generating-function comparison, an exact positive balancing cost, unique budget optimizers, a sharp unboundedness threshold at total loss one, and a simple law for the extremizer. These are natural structural facts for a nonmonotone coupon process and avoid a merely numerical or arbitrary slice.
